text.formatted: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.
text.plain: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

gaps.name: Metamagic options are not typed, so their costs cannot be waived while Innate Sorcery is active.
